QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Lost Child
QuestInfo.0: Loha has a request. Make sure you listen carefully this time. Last time was awful.
QuestInfo.1: Go ask Sion in the Tent House if Crawls with Balrog liked the Snail Porridge, and if there is anything else she needs.
QuestInfo.2: You visited Sion and asked about little Crawls with Balrog.

0.0: Kao! I've got an easy request for you, all right? Go ask Sion in the Tent House if Crawls with Balrog liked the Snail Porridge. You might as well see if she needs anything else, too.

yes.0: Then get going. Babies are very, very demanding, but she never complains. Sion is like an angel.

no.0: Do you need time to prepare yourself or something? I know she can be scary...

1.0: Kao! You're just in time! I need help!\r\n#L0##bWhat's going on? Loha's sent me over...#l\n#k

npc.0: You haven't left yet? Quit being so lazy! I think it's time you stopped hanging out with Tess!
